title: Finder reveals wrong sibling for a filename with parentheses
body: macOS 15, Electron 42.4.1: shell.showItemInFolder targeting Report (final).pdf in a directory also containing Report.pdf opens that directory but selects Report.pdf. Renaming the target without parentheses fixes selection. shell.openPath on the original target succeeds.

title: shell.openPath reports Failed to open path for missing PDF
body: shell.openPath returns Failed to open path when Report (final).pdf has already been deleted from disk. Creating the target resolves the error. Finder selection and shell.showItemInFolder are unaffected.
